svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Cloud Detective daily scan on AWS. 1. EventBridge Scheduler invokes the scanner Lambda every day at 01:30 UTC. 2. The scanner reads the account registry, which the dashboard writes when an account is onboarded. 3. For each member account it assumes the cloud-detective-readonly role. 4. Findings are reconciled in DynamoDB as new, open or resolved, only for the accounts this run scanned. 5. Cost, inventory and posture snapshots go to the reports bucket. 6. SNS emails a plain-text digest. The scanner's role allows only describe, list and get calls on scanned services; it writes only to its own table, bucket prefixes and topic. Optional Bedrock triage is off by default.
svg.text: AWS Account · where Cloud Detective runs
EventBridge Scheduler invokes the scanner Lambda every day at 01:30 UTC.
The scanner reads the account registry, which the dashboard writes when an account is onboarded.
For each member account it assumes the cloud-detective-readonly role.
Findings are reconciled in DynamoDB as new, open or resolved, only for the accounts this run scanned.
Cost, inventory and posture snapshots go to the reports bucket.
Dashed lines: reading the registry and assuming member roles.
The scanner's role allows only describe, list and get calls on scanned services;
it writes only to its own table, bucket prefixes and topic. Optional Bedrock triage is off by default.
